free_tier.stated: S3-compatible object storage with a slider up to 50 TB; priced at USD 100/month (USD 0.02/GB) for 5 TB stored; USD 20/TB at that tier.

egress.terms: Egress traffic* charges only apply to traffic outside of our CDN; USD 0.09/GB, initial 50 GB free. Requests USD 0.03 per 10k, initial 1M free. No egress fees between the storage and CDN77 delivery platform.

tooling: S3 API; 'Seamless integration with CDN77 delivery platform'. Growth plan is $990/mo for 250 TB traffic with $3.96/TB overage.
chaining: Origin storage integrates with CDN77 without separate origin egress charges. Storage at rest is priced at $20 per TB monthly.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none published. Storage at $0.03/10k requests after 1M free. Request pricing exists, unlike Bunny/CacheFly.
reliability_note: 330 Tbps, enterprise-oriented; sales-gated plans ('Talk to sales') rather than self-serve checkout. Also one of the few CDNs that explicitly sponsors OSS (Blender, GNOME, Let's Encrypt, Fedora, Manjaro). See the Fast Forward note.
